subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should OpenClaw make 16 MiB the unconditional maximum size for local and cloned marketplace manifests?
rationale: The bound prevents unbounded allocation, but selecting the permanent ceiling changes previously accepted input and real-world catalog-size evidence is not present in the discussion.

options.title: Accept 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Land the current implementation because 16 MiB provides substantial catalog headroom while placing a clear memory bound on every manifest source.

options.title: Raise the ceiling
options.body: Choose a larger fixed limit and update the constant, tests, and CLI proof before merge if maintainers expect very large catalogs.

options.title: Pause for catalog data
options.body: Hold the PR until representative marketplace sizes are measured if compatibility confidence is more important than landing the immediate bound.

recommendation.title: Accept 16 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Land the current implementation because 16 MiB provides substantial catalog headroom while placing a clear memory bound on every manifest source.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the marketplace feature and are best positioned to confirm its intended catalog-size contract.
